gates.plain: Run3 named its scored axis and fenced off six others, and notably left protein partners IN scope — which is consistent, since one of its five hypotheses is about partners.

gates.plain: Run3 declined to invent a hash, and its rule is the most defensive of the six — it names the `printf "$(cat ...)"` form as NOT equivalent because command substitution strips trailing newlines.
